name: Saturn Premium
author: Saturn AI
tagline: Cinematic deep space · cold near-black surfaces · one Saturn-gold accent · dark only
description: The Saturn AI identity, shipped dark-only. Depth is carried by a five-step luminance ladder and hairline strokes rather than by shadow or gradient, every neutral sits on a faint blue-violet cast so the surface reads as space rather than charcoal, and Saturn gold is the single earned accent — brand, focus, selection, primary action. Dark-only is a deliberate choice: upstream keys its own palette on the dark attribute, so a skin shipping a light default renders a white product whenever the theme fails to resolve. This one has no light state to fall into.
